# 公众号排版 · WeChat Layout

一个 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）客户端插件：在右侧文件面板选择 **doocs/md 排版**，
把 Markdown 渲染成可直接粘贴进微信公众号编辑器的富文本。样式参考
doocs

eepSeek Harness（DSH）客户端插件：在右侧文件面板选择 **doocs/md 排版**，
把 Markdown 渲染成可直接粘贴进微信公众号编辑器的富文本。样式参考
doocs/md。

A DSH client plugin that turns Markdown into WeChat official-account (公众号)
ready HTML, modelled on d

ient plugin that turns Markdown into WeChat official-account (公众号)
ready HTML, modelled on doocs/md.

- In the right Sidebar, opening a `.md` / `.markdown` file keeps the shipped
**Markdown** viewer by

default. The viewer dropdown gains a **doocs/md 排版**
option; selecting it renders the file as a WeCh

at article with theme controls
and a copy-icon button. The shipped **Plain text** viewer stays avail

able too.
- The viewer has three doocs/md themes (经典 / 优雅 / 简洁), five accent
colours, and 14–18px bo

dy sizes. Preferences persist per browser.
- The copy-icon button writes the rendered article to the

clipboard as rich HTML
(`text/html` + `text/plain`); paste it into the WeChat editor and the inline

styles survive.
- A leading YAML frontmatter block is treated as document metadata and omitted
from
the article; the rest of the file renders normally.
## Why it can be pasted into WeChat

The WeChat editor discards `<style>` blocks and class selectors, so the renderer
bakes every rule in

to `style` attributes: headings, paragraphs, quotes, lists,
tables, code, links and images all carry

inline CSS. Relative styles are
resolved from the theme before rendering; no stylesheet, web font,

CDN script,
or network request is involved.

The right-Sidebar viewer is a `documentPreviews` implementation: it registers
`md`/`markdown` for `t

ext-pages` loading under the id
`@local/wechat-md/file-preview`. Its `builtin` priority registers it

beside the
shipped Markdown viewer, so Markdown stays the default and doocs/md is a
dropdown choice
; use `priority: 'extension'` to make it the default instead.

The Markdown parser is marked v15 (MIT),
vendored into `client.js`. Raw HTML in the Markdown is sani

tized (scripts,
frames, form controls, `on*` handlers and `javascript:` URLs are removed) before
it
reaches the preview or the clipboard.

## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- `src/markdown.js` — theme style maps and the marked renderer (pure, no React).
- `src/ui.js` — the

right-Sidebar document viewer and its registration.
- `src/marked.min.js` — vendored marked build;

ar document viewer and its registration.
- `src/marked.min.js` — vendored marked build; do not edit.
## Known limits

- No Mermaid/PlantUML/KaTeX/emoji/GFM-alert extensions; code blocks are not
syntax-highlighted (dooc

s/md has all of these).
- Images keep their Markdown URLs. In the right-Sidebar viewer, relative loc

al
images are resolved through the authenticated file route so the preview shows
them; the copied HT

ML still carries the authored URL, so a relative image will
not load in WeChat until you upload it.

Public HTTP(S) images are re-hosted by
WeChat on paste.
- The preview is the clipboard payload, not

an iframe of the WeChat editor, so
WeChat-side quirks (e.g. table scrolling on small screens) cannot

be
previewed exactly.
- The plugin is a viewer only; it does not edit files or add a chat entry.

Themes are adapted from doocs/md's WTFPL-licensed theme styles; the
WeChat-layout UI is written for

DSH. See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
for the full marked, Markdown, and doocs/md license texts.
